analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 420-798). No patch hunks or head text were supplied, so the actual added or removed lines are not visible and this pass cannot judge them. CHANGELOG.md is documentation only and has no runtime effect, so I found no concrete regression.

The excerpts describe security-relevant behavior that the integration pass should compare against code changes in the same PR:
- Fail-closed attestation challenges (a missing status_signature or an omitted secure_boot_enabled now fails), and App Attest serving at protocol 3 only. These relate to TB-002, TB-009, TB-011, T-036 and T-052..T-058.
- Removal of the unauthenticated GET /v1/provider/earnings route (T-031) and of the telemetry route.
- The EIGENINFERENCE_MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION floor, which now excludes providers that report no version. The changelog says the live value must be raised by hand (500).
- Account-scoped first-content SLA, cache-read billing, and SSD prefix-cache TTL raised to 30 minutes (SEC-035 re-acceptance, T-041).
- Durable build qualification and revocation (T-054), and the claim that the MDM profile stays copyable.

If the PR also changes code, the integration pass should check that the changelog claims match it. The threat model entries may need updating if the code changes the TB-002 or TB-009 limitations that currently describe status_signature as advisory. In TB-009 the status-signature text is already updated, but a TB-002 status paragraph and other older text may lag.
